text_block_list.text:
Inari One wasn't feeling well, so I 
brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, can't go worrying my partner. I'll 
make sure to get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Mm. Oh? Where am I? What festival is 
this?

text_block_list.name: Fox-Masked Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Seiya, seiya! ...Oh! Well if it ain't Big 
Sis Inari over there!

text_block_list.name: Fox-Masked Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hurry over here! It's a special 
Inari palanquin we prepared just for you, 
Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
A special Inari Mikoshi... What in the 
world?! That portable shrine is made out 
of fried tofu?!

text_block_list.name: Fox-Masked Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It's made of jumbo fried tofu! It's a 
stylish portable shrine you can tear a 
piece off and eat whenever you get hungry 
working up a sweat!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that really what you'd call 
'stylish'...?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, how could anyone see a portable 
shrine and NOT want to carry it?! Alright, 
count me in!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Gaaah! That's a magnificent portable 
shrine, steeped in a rich bonito broth 
flavor!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, hoist it up Edo-style! Here we 
go, heeve-ho, heeve-ho!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Great Inari-sama! Hype it up, heaving 
ho, Great Deity Inari!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looks like the whole crowd's getting 
fired up too! Hehehe, this is what a 
festival is all about—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh? ...Just a dream, huh. Man, what a 
letdown—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, even if it was just a dream, the 
passion was real.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I don't know who the hell's runnin' 
this whole dream thing, but thanks for the 
stylish setup!

Returning from the nurse's office, Inari 
One is visibly brimming with energy!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...W-Whoa? Hey, let me through! Isn't this 
place way too crowded...?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, dammit! I'm gettin' swept away by 
the crowd...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...What the heck, it was just a dream?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aah, dammit! That just made me remember 
getting lost as a brat! Now I'm completely 
pissed off!

Afterward, Inari One returned from the 
nurse's office, but she didn't seem to be 
doing much better...
